en: Black‑and‑white interior view of an elegant dining room with arched openings, long tables covered with white tablecloths, and rows of wooden chairs. Decorative light fixtures hang from the ceiling, and there is an ornate tiled stove or cabinet with painted panels on the right side. The word "Speisezimmer" (German for dining room) is printed in the lower right corner, indicating this is likely a formal restaurant or hotel dining hall.
